interpretation.sourceIndex: zero-based original transactions array index; order preserved
interpretation.transactionId: source value; repeats across sessions and is not a unique identifier
interpretation.rawPayloadEncoding: hexadecimal bytes in source order, little-endian scalar interpretation
interpretation.snapshotAndFindingNumbers: unsigned integers unless explicitly labeled; not byte strings
interpretation.responseOrigin: not independently established by this host-generated log
interpretation.events: host-recorded camera_lost/camera_back, not proof of a power cycle; experiment_context keeps the operator's normalized AUTO UPDATE answer; bank_restore_verification keeps per-field statuses, not values
interpretation.operatorObservations: reviewed normalized observations with explicit source pointers; not independent menu or power telemetry
interpretation.liveD1A5: live setting sampled while a bank was selected, not a 24th bank field

omissions: bank names and all D18D payloads except the two empty-name encodings (00 and 010000)
source verdict prose and ok flags
unrestricted source strings and unknown fields
transform.generatedFacts: No missing times, connection identifiers, conditions, or hardware observations are invented; finding interpretations are labeled.
